questions.question: The shell is unusable here: bubblewrap can't create a namespace, so every bash command (including `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6`) is refused. How should I get the byte dump and verification?

options.label: Turn off the shell sandbox so I can run it
options.description: Set [sandbox] bash = "off" (global config). Runs commands unconfined — the container becomes the only boundary.

options.label: Leave it off; I'll run od myself
options.description: You run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` in your own shell; I close the item as user-verified.

options.label: Accept the read_file inspection as verification
options.description: content is confirmed correct, but no command is run — the od bytes stay unshown.
